project.name: simulators
project.description:
Aggregator for the simulated business services.
These are NOT part of the traffic-management platform. They are the test environment: realistic upstreams so the platform has traffic to manage. Grouping them under one aggregator keeps that distinction visible in the module list itself - `common`, `rule-service`, and `deployment-service` are the platform; everything under `simulators/` is the thing being managed.
Per docs/roadmap.md, a simulator that imports a platform module is a design error, not a shortcut. They must remain able to run with this repository's other modules deleted.
